premise: I cashed out $142,000 from 33 years as a paramedic to start a medical-billing and coding company with my daughter-in-law, who notarized 50/50 and free claim audits for my old ambulance crew, then she forged a digital signature on a dissolution, sold the patient accounts to a national billing group for $860,000, and sent me a $4,900 'EOB' check; I traced the forgery through IP logs and document metadata, voided the sale, and now run 'Code of Deceit Billing,' where she shreds denials in a lab coat that says 'Coded Me Out' and every claim form prints the fraud docket.
